q: The government decided to impose a high _____ on all imported cars from abroad.
explain: tariff  n. 关税，税率。
translation: 政府决定对所有从国外进口的汽车征收高额关税。

q: She could not _____ the pain any longer and went to see a doctor.
explain: bear  v. 忍受，承受。
translation: 她再也无法忍受疼痛，于是去看了医生。

q: The old stone gate _____ the name of the man who built it.
explain: bear  v. 刻有（名字、标记等）。
translation: 那座古老的石门刻有建造它的那个人的名字。

q: Doctors warn that people _____ with the virus should stay at home to avoid spreading it.
explain: infect  v. 感染，传染。
translation: 医生警告说，感染了这种病毒的人应该待在家里以避免传播。

q: If you do not clean the wound properly, you could get a serious _____.
explain: infection  n. 感染，传染病。
translation: 如果你不正确地清理伤口，你可能会得严重的感染。

q: The cobra is one of the world's _____ snakes and can kill a person in minutes.
explain: deadly  adj. 致命的。
translation: 眼镜蛇是世界上最致命的蛇之一，能在几分钟内致人死亡。

q: Doctors are very concerned about an _____ of tuberculosis in an East London school.
explain: outbreak  n. 爆发，突然发生。
translation: 医生们对东伦敦一所学校爆发的肺结核疫情非常担忧。

q: Some members of the family may remain _____ by the disease even when others become ill.
explain: unaffected  adj. 未受影响的。
translation: 即使其他家庭成员生病，有些家庭成员也可能不受这种疾病的影响。

q: The disease _____ the central nervous system and can cause serious long-term damage.
explain: affect  v. 影响。
translation: 这种疾病会影响中枢神经系统，并可能造成严重的长期损害。

q: This new type of infection is _____ to antibiotics, so doctors must find other treatments.
explain: resistant  adj. 有抵抗力的，抵抗的。
translation: 这种新型感染对抗生素具有抗药性，因此医生必须寻找其他治疗方法。

q: The _____ American has not even thought about next year's election yet.
explain: average  adj. 普通的，平常的。
translation: 普通美国人甚至还没有考虑明年的选举。

q: The people rose up and _____ the cruel leader after years of suffering.
explain: overthrow  v. 推翻，打倒。
translation: 在多年苦难之后，人民奋起推翻了那个残暴的领导人。

q: A republic was declared following the _____ of the monarchy in that country.
explain: overthrow  n. 推翻，打倒。
translation: 在那个国家的君主制被推翻后，共和国宣告成立。

q: On the way to the airport, we _____ a battered old Renault on the highway.
explain: overtake  v. 超过，赶上。
translation: 在去机场的路上，我们在高速公路上超过了一辆破旧的雷诺汽车。

q: The huge trees offered _____ from the sun, so we sat down to rest.
explain: shade  n. 阴凉处，背阴处。
translation: 巨大的树木提供了遮阳的阴凉处，所以我们坐下来休息。

q: To the _____ of his proud parents, he has made a full recovery from the illness.
explain: delight  n. 高兴，愉快。
translation: 令他自豪的父母高兴的是，他已经从疾病中完全康复了。

q: Several countries have pledged millions of dollars to help the _____ of the tsunami.
explain: victim  n. 受害者，牺牲品。
translation: 几个国家已经承诺提供数百万美元来帮助海啸的受害者。

q: The police managed to gain _____ to the building through an upstairs window.
explain: access  n. 进入，使用权。
translation: 警察设法通过楼上的窗户进入了那栋建筑。

q: It suddenly _____ to me that I had left my keys inside the locked car.
explain: occur  v. 想到，想起（it occurs to sb.）。
translation: 我突然想到我把钥匙忘在了锁着的车里。

q: The change in the law has been welcomed by banks and other financial _____.
explain: institution  n. 机构，制度。
translation: 法律的这一变化受到了银行和其他金融机构的欢迎。

q: The best home _____ for a sore throat is honey and lemon, according to my grandmother.
explain: remedy  n. 治疗方法，补救办法。
translation: 我祖母说，治疗喉咙痛最好的家庭疗法是蜂蜜和柠檬。

q: Eventually we found a doctor who was able to _____ her of her depression.
explain: cure  v. 治愈，治好。
translation: 最终我们找到了一位能够治好她抑郁症的医生。

q: As yet there is no known _____ for the disease, but scientists are working hard.
explain: cure  n. 治疗方法，药物。
translation: 目前这种疾病尚无已知的治疗方法，但科学家们正在努力研究。

q: The peace talks between the two countries are at a _____ stage right now.
explain: delicate  adj. 微妙的，需要谨慎处理的。
translation: 两国之间的和平谈判目前正处于一个微妙的阶段。

q: She trained hard every day and soon began to _____ all her teammates on the track.
explain: outshine  v. 比……更出色，使黯然失色。
translation: 她每天刻苦训练，很快便开始在跑道上使所有队友黯然失色。

q: In recent years, the Austrian economy has _____ most other industrial economies in the region.
explain: outperform  v. 表现优于，胜过。
translation: 近年来，奥地利的经济表现优于该地区大多数其他工业经济体。

q: In this profession, women _____ men by two to one, which shows how much the field has changed.
explain: outnumber  v. 在数量上超过。
translation: 在这个行业中，女性人数以二比一超过男性，这表明该领域发生了多大的变化。

q: The project has just entered its final _____, and everyone is working extra hours to meet the deadline.
explain: phase  n. 阶段，时期。
translation: 这个项目刚刚进入最后阶段，每个人都在加班加点以赶上截止日期。

q: The school team won five games _____, which made the whole campus very proud.
explain: successively  adv. 连续不断地，一个接一个地。
translation: 校队连续赢了五场比赛，这让整个校园都非常自豪。

q: She _____ to the throne in 1558 after the death of her half-sister.
explain: succeed  v. 继承（职位、王位等）。
translation: 她在同父异母的姐姐去世后于1558年继承了王位。

q: The team has had five _____ victories this season, and the fans are delighted.
explain: successive  adj. 连续的，接连的。
translation: 这支球队本赛季已经取得了五连胜，球迷们非常高兴。

q: The more expensive articles are not _____ better, so you should compare them carefully before buying.
explain: necessarily  adv. 必然地，一定地。
translation: 较贵的东西不一定就更好，所以购买前你应该仔细比较。

q: _____ has largely replaced physical media for watching movies at home over the past decade.
explain: streaming  n. 流媒体（服务），在线播放。
translation: 在过去十年里，流媒体已基本取代了实体媒介成为人们在家看电影的方式。

q: The company plans to _____ its new service to coincide with the World Cup this summer.
explain: launch  v. 发起，推出（产品、活动等）。
translation: 该公司计划在今年夏天世界杯期间推出其新服务。

q: After two years of college, the students have a much more _____ attitude toward their studies.
explain: mature  adj. 成熟的，理智的。
translation: 经过两年的大学生活，学生们对学习的态度成熟了许多。

q: The government wields enormous _____ over the economy, which affects everyone's daily life.
explain: power  n. 权力，操控力。
translation: 政府对经济拥有巨大的权力，这影响着每个人的日常生活。

q: Investors were _____ funds from U.S. stocks to Asian markets as the trade situation changed.
explain: shift  v. 转移，改变。
translation: 随着贸易形势的变化，投资者正将资金从美国股市转移到亚洲市场。

q: Most of the articles on that website require a _____, so you cannot read them for free.
explain: subscription  n. 订阅（费），订阅服务。
translation: 那个网站上的大多数文章都需要订阅才能阅读，所以你无法免费查看。

q: The library _____ to forty magazines so that readers can enjoy a variety of topics.
explain: subscribe  v. 订阅，订购。
translation: 图书馆订阅了四十种杂志，以便读者能够享受各种不同的主题。

q: She paused on the edge of the stage, trying to _____ her balance before the performance began.
explain: regain  v. 重新获得，恢复。
translation: 她在舞台边缘停顿了一下，试图在表演开始前恢复平衡。

q: I need to _____ my passport this year because it will expire in December.
explain: renew  v. 续订，延长……的有效期。
translation: 我今年需要续办护照，因为它将在十二月到期。

q: He remained strongly _____ that an agreement could be reached before the deadline.
explain: optimistic  adj. 乐观的。
translation: 他仍然非常乐观，认为能够在截止日期前达成协议。

q: He's quite _____ about his chances of getting another job in this difficult market.
explain: pessimistic  adj. 悲观的。
translation: 在当前这个困难的市场环境下，他对自己找到另一份工作的机会相当悲观。

q: She has always remained _____ to her political principles, even when it was not easy.
explain: loyal  adj. 忠诚的，忠实的。
translation: 她始终信守自己的政治原则，即使在困难的时候也是如此。

q: The sun _____ from behind the clouds, and the whole valley suddenly lit up.
explain: emerge  v. 出现，显现。
translation: 太阳从云层后面露出来，整个山谷突然亮了起来。

q: The monthly fee is fixed and there are no hidden _____ that you need to worry about.
explain: extra  n. 额外的事物，附加费用。
translation: 月费是固定的，没有你需要担心的隐藏额外费用。

q: These are the Chinese _____ meaning wind and water, and they appear in many ancient books.
explain: character  n. （书写或印刷的）符号，字符。
translation: 这些是意为“风”和“水”的汉字，它们出现在许多古书中。

q: I wrote to them last month and I am _____ waiting for a reply from their office.
explain: still  adv. 仍然，还是。
translation: 我上个月给他们写了信，我仍然在等他们办公室的回复。

q: He was so _____ in his book that he did not hear anybody knocking at the door.
explain: absorb  v. 使全神贯注（be absorbed in）。
translation: 他如此全神贯注于他的书，以至于没有听见有人敲门。

q: The _____ teacher explained the difficult lesson in a very simple way.
explain: experience  v. 经历（experienced 有经验的）。
translation: 这位有经验的老师用非常简单的方式讲解了那节难课。

q: She _____ a moment of great joy when her son came home.
explain: experience  v. 经历，体验。
translation: 儿子回家时，她经历了一阵巨大的喜悦。

q: The most useful _____ of this new phone is its very long battery life.
explain: feature  n. 特点，特征。
translation: 这部新手机最有用的特点是电池续航时间很长。

q: The new museum will _____ many works by young local artists.
explain: feature  v. 以……为特色，包含……作为重要部分。
translation: 新博物馆将展出许多当地年轻艺术家的作品。

q: The small team worked hard to _____ the project before the winter break.
explain: advance  v. 前进，进展，促进。
translation: 这个小组努力工作，以在寒假前推进这个项目。

q: Medical science has made great _____ in the past fifty years.
explain: advance  n. 进步，进展。
translation: 医学在过去五十年里取得了巨大进步。

q: Please give us _____ notice if you plan to visit our office.
explain: advance  adj. 预先的，事先的。
translation: 如果你计划来我们办公室，请提前通知我们。

q: The children sat on the _____ and shared their lunch with each other.
explain: ground  n. 地面，场地。
translation: 孩子们坐在地上，互相分享午餐。

q: There is no _____ for believing that the weather will improve tomorrow.
explain: ground  n. 理由，根据。
translation: 没有理由相信明天天气会好转。

q: The airline _____ all its planes because of the heavy snow.
explain: ground  v. 使停飞，禁止飞行。
translation: 由于大雪，这家航空公司停飞了所有飞机。

q: Her argument is _____ in years of careful research.
explain: ground  v. 把……建立在……基础上。
translation: 她的论点建立在多年仔细研究的基础上。

q: The company showed a strong _____ to protecting the local environment.
explain: commitment  n. 承诺，投入，奉献。
translation: 这家公司表现出对保护当地环境的坚定承诺。

q: The ringing bell was a clear _____ that the class had ended.
explain: signal  n. 信号，标志。
translation: 响起的铃声清楚地表明课已经结束了。

q: The driver _____ to us that we could cross the road safely.
explain: signal  v. 发信号，示意。
translation: 司机向我们示意，我们可以安全过马路。

q: Winning that prize was a _____ success for the young scientist.
explain: signal  adj. 显著的，重大的。
translation: 赢得那个奖项对这位年轻科学家来说是一次重大成功。

q: Good communication is _____ to the success of any team project.
explain: critical  adj. 关键的，至关重要的。
translation: 良好的沟通对任何团队项目的成功都至关重要。

q: The report was very _____ of the way the money was spent.
explain: critical  adj. 批评的，批判的。
translation: 这份报告对这笔钱的使用方式提出了严厉批评。

q: The patient is in a _____ condition and needs care day and night.
explain: critical  adj. 危急的，严重的。
translation: 病人情况危急，需要日夜照护。

q: She studied English _____ at university and later became a teacher.
explain: literature  n. 文学。
translation: 她在大学学习英国文学，后来成为一名教师。

q: The doctor read the latest _____ on heart disease before the operation.
explain: literature  n. 文献，资料。
translation: 手术前，医生阅读了关于心脏病的最新文献。

q: They decided to _____ their stay in the countryside for another week.
explain: prolong  v. 延长，拖延。
translation: 他们决定在乡下再待一周，延长逗留时间。

q: _____ arriving at the station, she called her parents to say she was safe.
explain: upon  prep. 一……就（on/upon + n./doing）。
translation: 一到车站，她就给父母打电话报平安。

q: The cat sat _____ the old wooden table and watched the birds outside.
explain: upon  prep. 在……上。
translation: 猫坐在旧木桌上，看着外面的鸟。

q: Could you _____ me carry these heavy boxes to the third floor?
explain: help  v. 帮助。
translation: 你能帮我把这些重箱子搬到三楼吗？

q: She can't _____ laughing whenever she hears that funny story.
explain: help  v. 忍不住，避免（can't help doing）。
translation: 她每次听到那个好笑的故事都忍不住笑起来。

q: Your _____ with the cooking made the party much easier for everyone.
explain: help  n. 帮助。
translation: 你在做饭上的帮助让大家的聚会轻松多了。

q: Only a _____ of people came to the meeting yesterday.
explain: handful  n. 少数，少量。
translation: 昨天只有少数几个人来开会。

q: The men _____ that they were out of the country when the crime was committed.
explain: maintain  v. 坚称，坚持认为。
translation: 那些男人坚称案发时他们不在国内。

q: It is _____ that women did not have the vote until that time.
explain: remarkable  adj. 非凡的，显著的。
translation: 令人瞩目的是，直到那时女性还没有投票权。

q: I met her quite by _____ at the airport last week.
explain: chance  n. 偶然，意外（by chance 偶然，碰巧）。
translation: 上周我在机场完全是偶然遇到她的。

q: She has _____ medicine in this city for over twenty years.
explain: practice  v. 行医，从事医疗工作。
translation: 她在这座城市行医已有二十多年。

q: The rain _____ against the windows all night long.
explain: lash  v. 猛烈拍打，抽打。
translation: 大雨整夜猛烈地拍打着窗户。

q: The police are responsible for _____ the law in this area.
explain: enforce  v. 执行，实施。
translation: 警方负责在这个地区执法。

q: Businesses want new laws to _____ the late payment of debts.
explain: counter  v. 反制，反击。
translation: 企业希望出台新法律来反制债务的延迟支付。

q: A delicious _____ of fresh coffee filled the entire room.
explain: aroma  n. 芳香，香味。
translation: 新鲜咖啡的诱人香味弥漫了整个房间。

q: She decided to _____ from her job at the end of the month.
explain: resign  v. 辞职。
translation: 她决定在月底辞去工作。

q: Help was at _____ when the accident happened on the highway.
explain: hand  n. （at hand 即将到来，在附近）。
translation: 高速公路上发生事故时，援助就在附近。

q: Thousands of people cross the _____ between the two countries every day.
explain: border  n. 边界，边境。
translation: 每天有成千上万的人穿越两国之间的边界。

q: The study of the brain is often described as the next intellectual _____.
explain: frontier  n. 前沿，尖端领域。
translation: 对大脑的研究常被描述为下一个智力前沿。

q: We saw the _____ outline of the mountain through the thick mist.
explain: faint  adj. 模糊的，微弱的。
translation: 透过浓雾，我们看见了那座山模糊的轮廓。
